newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Interior Ministry has warned foreigners not to provide accommodation to anyone whose name is not mentioned in the rental agreement.
- Saudi Arabia is to pay 3.2 billion riyals to farmers in dues.
- Pakistan is sending a high-level trade delegation to Saudi Arabia next month.
- Around 10,000 date trees abandoned by owners face ruin in Saudi Arabia.
- Saudi Arabia granted 26 million riyals to Bosnia to build mosques.
- Saudi investors participated in setting up a bank in Russia with a capital of $20 million.
- Authorities are questioning a contractor and a consultant over the collpase of a building which injured seven workers in Khobar on Sunday.
- Municipal projects worth 112 million riyals are to be set up in Madinah.
